scope: Third targeted closure pass over previously researched municipalities with hard-source or mixed legal/application residuals.

records.closureSearchResult: Current municipal page now explicitly confirms that room rental requires an omgevingsvergunning via Omgevingsloket, with minimum room size 13 m2 GBO and 12 m2 for labour-migrant accommodation. For dwelling splitting, a change of the Omgevingsplan is required and an omgevingsvergunning is also required for the alteration, even when the work remains within the existing walls.

Fresh official-source review materially improves the application side. Asten's current Omgevingsvergunning route and 2026 Legesverordening are active. The current brandveilig-gebruik page confirms that room-by-room letting with five or more residential units triggers a fire-safety use notification, submitted through Omgevingsloket with a tailored form and uploaded attachments; legal use must already be secured and, if not, the spatial/building permit must be obtained first. The Leegstandwet product also explicitly warns that room rental can require a spatial-plan exemption/permission.
closedNonAddressItems: fire-safety notification trigger for 5+ room-rental units
relationship between fire-safety use and spatial/building legality
remaining: specific substantive ordinary room-rental and dwelling-splitting framework outside fire-safety/Leegstandwet contexts

records.closureSearchResult: The current municipal Omgevingsvergunning product is sufficiently explicit on the practical route: Vergunningcheck and application through Omgevingsloket, DigiD for private applicants and eHerkenning for businesses, 8-week regular processing with possible extension, activity-dependent fees and a concrete generic drawing set including floor plans, site plan, elevations, sections and current/new situation. Repeated targeted searches still did not surface a municipality-specific current ordinary room-rental/splitting policy or housing-stock regime.
remaining: municipality-specific substantive ordinary room-rental/splitting framework after repeated official-source search

records.closureSearchResult: A current municipal Woning splitsen product was found and retested. It states that an owner seeking to split a dwelling applies for a permit with Omgevingsdienst Groene Metropool (ODGM); an additional omgevingsvergunning may be necessary for building/alteration and can be filed through Omgevingsloket. The current generic omgevingsvergunning page confirms DigiD/eHerkenning, floor plans, site plan, elevations, sections, current/new drawings and regular 8-week processing with possible 6-week extension.
closedNonAddressItems: existence of a dedicated current dwelling-splitting permit route
remaining: exact splitting permit evidence/fee beyond generic omgevingsvergunning requirements

records.closureSearchResult: Current official municipal pages materially clarify the practical spatial route. Applicants use the Omgevingsloket/Vergunningcheck; ordinary omgevingsvergunning applications may require calculations/building drawings, floor plans, site plan, elevations, cross-sections and current/new drawings. For use contrary to the Omgevingsplan, DigiD/eHerkenning, current-use evidence, proposed-use description, current/new site/building drawings, area-impact description, conflict explanation, motivation and—if available—archaeological reporting are listed. The municipality itself warns that some legacy website text may be stale after the 2024 Omgevingswet, so Omgevingsloket/current law controls. Repeated targeted search still did not surface a specific current ordinary room-rental/splitting municipal regime.
remaining: municipality-specific substantive ordinary room-rental/splitting framework after repeated official-source search

qualityRule: A dedicated current product can close the application-route question without proving every substantive housing rule. Repeated failure to find a municipal substantive regime is recorded explicitly and never converted into a no-rule conclusion.
